column1: # Golden cases whose FORMULA Excel refuses to enter at all (found by
# find_rejects.py: Excel declines to open a workbook containing it, -50).
# These are arity violations Excel rejects at parse time; the engine instead
# accepts the text and evaluates it to an error. generate.py leaves the host
# cell empty for them and read.py records type `rejected`; the Rust lane
# treats them as documented divergences (Excel has no value to compare).
